name: Heubad-Wellness im Volderwildbad
beschreibung:
=== description ===
A **Heubad** at **Volderwildbad** is a centuries-old Tyrolean tradition. The warm water and aromatic plant oils from the hay create a soothing effect on muscles and respiratory systems. The historic spa from the 19th century adds a uniquely authentic atmosphere to your visit. Perfectly paired with a herbal compress.
